text_block_list.text:
Viiictory! That was darn amazin',
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:

with
friends!

text_block_list.text:
Let's have a party to celebrate our win!
C'mon,
time to get all the fixin's we
need for a big ol'
BBQ bash tonight!
